# CivicResolve (Civics Project) - Repository Information

## GitHub Repository Description (284 / 300 Characters Max)

> CivicResolve is an interactive civic engagement platform built with Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, TypeScript, and Leaflet maps. It enables citizens to report local issues, track resolution timelines with authorities, join volunteer drives, and fund campaigns via zero-fee QR donations.

---

---

## Tech Stack Overview

- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack)
- **UI Library**: React 19
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4
- **Maps & Location**: Leaflet & React-Leaflet
- **Authentication**: NextAuth.js v5 (Mongoose adapter)
- **Database**: MongoDB & Mongoose v9
- **Media & Email**: Cloudinary & Resend API
